Calculating module scores for selected pathways in cardiomyocytes and fibroblast for each of 4 samples

2026-07-08

Importing necessary libraries

# Function to load libraries with automatic installation
load_libraries <- function(lib_name, bioconductor = FALSE) {
  if (!require(lib_name, character.only = TRUE)) {
    if (bioconductor) {
      BiocManager::install(lib_name)
    } else {
      install.packages(lib_name)
    }
    require(lib_name, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

Calculating scores from extracted genes for each pathway:

extract_genes_from_pathways <- function(gsea_object, pathways){
  
  selected <- gsea_object[
    grepl(
      paste(pathways, collapse="|"),
      gsea_object$Description,
      ignore.case = TRUE
    ),
  ]
  
  genes <- unique(
    unlist(
      strsplit(selected$core_enrichment, "/")
    )
  )
  
  return(genes)
}
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)


extract_module_score <- function(
    seurat_obj,
    gsea_object,
    pathway_sets,
    score_prefix = ""
){
  
  for(i in names(pathway_sets)){
    
    # wyciągnięcie Entrez ID z pathway
    genes_entrez <- extract_genes_from_pathways(
      gsea_object,
      pathway_sets[[i]]
    )
    
    
    # Entrez -> Symbol
    genes_symbol <- mapIds(
      org.Hs.eg.db,
      keys = genes_entrez,
      keytype = "ENTREZID",
      column = "SYMBOL",
      multiVals = "first"
    )
    
    genes_symbol <- unique(
      na.omit(genes_symbol)
    )
    
    
    # dopasowanie do genów w Seurat
    genes_final <- intersect(
      genes_symbol,
      rownames(seurat_obj)
    )
    
    
    message(
      i,
      ": ",
      length(genes_final),
      " genes"
    )
    
    
    if(length(genes_final) >= 5){
      
      seurat_obj <- AddModuleScore(
        seurat_obj,
        features = list(genes_final),
        name = paste0(score_prefix, i)
      )
      
    } else {
      
      seurat_obj[[paste0(score_prefix,i,"1")]] <- NA
      
    }
    
  }
  
  return(seurat_obj)
}

Giving scores to fibro and Cardio:

Fibro <- extract_module_score(
  seurat_obj = Fibro,
  gsea_object = object_all_fibro,
  pathway_sets = pathway_sets,
  score_prefix = "Fibro_"
)
